speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception. The combination of an 8-month-old boy with intermittent abdominal pain (crying when touched), feeding difficulties, and an X-ray showing dilated bowel loops with an air-filled rectum (absence of gas) is highly suggestive of a mechanical obstruction, most commonly intussusception in this age group. The "currant jelly" stool mentioned in your script is also a classic late sign, though the X-ray findings confirm the obstruction. Please prepare for an ultrasound to confirm the diagnosis and potential for reduction.
